instructions.question: What attitude does the poster of this Serbian tweet show: positive (warmth, joy, enthusiasm, upbeat sharing), negative (displeasure, sadness, sarcasm, mockery or self-put-down), or neutral (no evaluative tone)?
instructions.rule: Negative covers sarcasm and mock praise, ridicule of people's habits, looks, couples, social media or politicians, and self-mockery admitting a real failing (laziness, procrastination, stupidity, ugliness), even when funny. Puns, wordplay, absurd or exaggerated anecdotes without a real failing, earnest opinions, questions, information and banter are neutral. If unsure between neutral and negative, and there is no clear target of ridicule and no displeasure word, choose neutral. Positive covers warmth, laughter, cheering, wishes, compliments and upbeat shares such as new songs, wins or good news.

neutral.what: Information, routine news, plans, questions, aphorisms, banter, earnest opinions, puns and absurd or exaggerated stories without a real failing or target.
examples: Igraš košarku za Zadar, prezivaš se Šutalo a nemaš neki šut - gle ironije. (You play for Zadar, your surname is Šutalo, and you can't shoot - irony.)
RT @paprikaupavlaci: -ustaj da učiš *pokrivam se preko glave umotam se u pokrivač i otkotrljam se u Tadzikistan* (-get up and study *I pull the blanket over my head and roll off to Tajikistan*)
Sednica SB UN o Kosovu 10. februara u Njujorku (UN SC session on Kosovo Feb 10 in New York)
neutral.cues: wordplay, kao (like), jel (is it), dates, link-only shares, sincere advice
neutral.not_for: Mocking someone or admitting one's own failing is negative. Enthusiastic sharing is positive.

positive.what: Warmth, joy, enthusiasm, laughter, cheering, greetings, compliments, wishes or daydreams. Also upbeat promotional or good-news shares.
examples: @pUnaVuna jel ti radis ili rtw-ujes :-) Elem, do jaja si :-) (are you working or retweeting :-) anyway, you're awesome)
Uskoro , jos jedna nova pesma ... Puno novosti u narednom periodu , zato pratite nas ... (Soon, another new song... lots of news ahead, follow us...)
Velečasni @Kole_srb dobio aplauz na izlasku iz tunela #kkcz (Reverend @Kole_srb got applause coming out of the tunnel)
positive.cues: HAHAHA, ajmo (come on), pozdrav (greetings), do jaja (awesome), car (king), nova pesma (new song), aplauz (applause), ;) :*
positive.not_for: Mock praise is negative. A plain reply with only a smiley is neutral.

negative.what: Displeasure, boredom, sadness, admitted failings, sarcasm, and ridicule of people, habits, politics or media. Also crime or scandal headlines.
examples: Moje pauze od ucenja traju duze nego samo ucenje (My study breaks last longer than the studying)
Zajednicki fejsbuk profili parova imaju smisla koliko i profili necijeg kera, fetusa ili tek rodjene bebe (Couples' shared Facebook profiles make as much sense as a dog's, a fetus's or a newborn's)
Mrzim ponedeljak (I hate Monday)
negative.cues: mrzim (I hate), najgore (the worst), dosadno (boring), debil (idiot), ironic pametno (smart), jebi ga (damn), :( , ubijen (killed)
negative.not_for: Puns and absurd exaggeration without a target are neutral. Affectionate teasing is positive or neutral.
